tasks.label: GitHub Preflight
args: git status && git branch --show-current && git remote -v && gh --version && gh auth status

tasks.label: Create Repo And Push Main
args: git add . && git commit -m "Initial commit" && gh repo create threedimos-3 --source . --remote origin --push --public

tasks.label: GitHub Postcheck
args: git log --oneline -n 1 && git remote -v && gh repo view threedimos-3 --json name,url,defaultBranchRef
